content: {"reasoning": "The denial is CO-197 (missing prior auth); this payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer, so those actions would be rule violations. Resubmitting clean or with records again won't cure an auth-at-time-of-service defect, and under a Medicare Advantage contract an auth failure is provider liability, so billing the patient is improper. The only legitimate path to collect the $549.76 is a formal appeal arguing medical necessity, supported by reasonably strong documentation (0.85), well within the 143-day filing window.", "action": "appeal_with_necessity"}
